item.title: Japanese Charts: Pikmin 4 Makes A Lukewarm Debut On Switch 2 As Zelda Dominates

description.p: Oli-marred.The latest Japanese charts data is in, and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time has comfortably maintained its lead with another 86,097 sales. Next in line is Metaphor: ReFantazio as its hits the Switch 2, shifting a total of 11,167 units.Pikmin 4 - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy also made its debut, selling just 2,854 copies to land at number 9. Now, it's important to note that many owners of the game on Switch 1 will have simply bought the upgrade pack, which won't count toward this total, however the game has also seen its fair share of controversy soon after release.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: 8BitDo Reveals Its Own GameCube Controller For Switch 2

description.p: And it's more affordable than Nintendo's.8BitDo, known for its work in providing excellent retro-inspired controllers for modern systems, has announced the GC Bluetooth Gamepad to celebrate the GameCube's 25th anniversary. It's currently scheduled to launch on 10th December 2026.Compatible with Switch, Switch 2, and Windows, the GC controller maintains the core shape and layout of the iconic GameCube pad, but adds in a bunch of modern upgrades like TMR sticks and Hall Effect triggers. Priced at $49.99, it undercuts Nintendo's official offering by $20 and is available for pre-order now.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
